rules: Cards describe what a tool computes and what can be varied. They never name a mechanism family and never recommend a tool for a purpose.

microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geomet.computes: Ground-state (S0) geometry optimization with the aTB1 tight-binding method (Amesp native optimizer; ASE BFGS fallback).
microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geomet.returns: An optimized S0 geometry (prepared_structure), final energy, optimizer used, convergence criterion and every optimizer attempt.

scope.input: initial_structure (used when the force-field preparation failed)

microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geomet.does_not_tell: Not a frequency-verified minimum; one conformer only; gas phase.

microscopic.list_rotatable_dihedrals.computes: Inventory of rotatable single-bond dihedrals of a structure (graph analysis, no calculation).
microscopic.list_rotatable_dihedrals.returns: Dihedral ids with their four 0-based atom indices, element symbols and central bond.
microscopic.list_rotatable_dihedrals.does_not_tell: Nothing about energetics or which rotation matters.

microscopic.run_baseline_bundle.computes: S0 optimization and vertical singlet excited states with aTB1/TDA (Amesp), gas phase.

you_can_vary.td_tout: transition output depth (>= 4 needed for hole-electron analysis)

microscopic.run_baseline_bundle.returns: Excitation energies, oscillator strengths and <S^2> of each state, the brightest state, dominant orbital transitions, ground- and excited-state transition dipoles, Mulliken charges; derived per state: radiative rate estimate (Strickler-Berg, gas phase) and gaps to neighbouring states.
microscopic.run_baseline_bundle.does_not_tell: Vertical states at one S0 geometry: no relaxed excited-state geometry, no triplets, no nonradiative rates; the radiative rate is an estimate from one oscillator strength.

microscopic.run_frontier_orbital_partiti.computes: Frontier orbital (HOMO/LUMO and neighbours) energies and their localization on two atom groups you define (aTB1).

you_can_vary.donor_atoms: 0-based atom indices of the first group
you_can_vary.acceptor_atoms: 0-based atom indices of the second group

microscopic.run_frontier_orbital_partiti.returns: Orbital energies and the fraction of each frontier orbital on each group.
microscopic.run_frontier_orbital_partiti.does_not_tell: Ground-state orbitals only; not excited-state charge transfer, not a transfer rate or free energy.

microscopic.run_charge_population_panel.computes: Ground-state atomic charges with up to four population schemes.

you_can_vary.charge_schemes: subset of Mulliken, Lowdin, Hirshfeld, CM5

microscopic.run_charge_population_panel.does_not_tell: Ground state only; charges are scheme-dependent partitions, not observables.

microscopic.run_solvation_polarity_proxy.computes: Vertical singlet excited states in several implicit solvents at the same geometry (aTB1/TDA).

you_can_vary.solvents: 2-4 of water, toluene, acetonitrile, methanol, ethanol, benzene, acetone, chloroform

microscopic.run_solvation_polarity_proxy.returns: Per solvent: excitation energies and oscillator strengths; shifts of the first state and of the brightest state between solvents.
microscopic.run_solvation_polarity_proxy.does_not_tell: Fixed geometry (no solvent relaxation), implicit solvent (no specific interactions), no emission spectrum.

microscopic.run_conformer_bundle.computes: Force-field conformers of the molecule and vertical excited states of each (aTB1/TDA).
microscopic.run_conformer_bundle.returns: Per conformer: geometry, relative energy, excitation energies and oscillator strengths.
microscopic.run_conformer_bundle.does_not_tell: Force-field conformers, not a converged ensemble or populations.

microscopic.run_torsion_brightness_coupl.computes: Rigid rotation of one dihedral to 2-6 angles; vertical excited states (aTB1/TDA) at each angle.

you_can_vary.dihedral_atoms: or the dihedral as four 0-based atom indices

microscopic.run_torsion_brightness_coupl.returns: Per angle: S0 relative energy, first excitation energy (vertical S1-S0 gap) and its oscillator strength, S1 energy relative to the S0 minimum of the scan; reusable rotated geometries.
microscopic.run_torsion_brightness_coupl.does_not_tell: Rigid snapshots: no relaxation of other coordinates, not an excited-state path, no barriers or rates.

microscopic.run_relaxed_coordinate_scan.computes: Constrained S0 scan of one bond length or dihedral with all other coordinates relaxed (aTB1 forces); vertical states at each point.

you_can_vary.state_root: 0 (ground state; excited-state relaxation is not available)

microscopic.run_relaxed_coordinate_scan.returns: Per point: converged geometry, actual coordinate value, S0 energy, vertical excitation energies; reusable geometries.

scope.charge: neutral unless the molecule is pure CHNO

microscopic.run_relaxed_coordinate_scan.does_not_tell: Ground-state relaxation only; not an excited-state path, barrier or rate.

microscopic.select_computed_geometry.computes: Picks one member (angle, conformer, scan point) from an earlier result as a new input geometry (no calculation).
microscopic.select_computed_geometry.returns: A prepared_structure with the same atom map.
microscopic.select_computed_geometry.does_not_tell: Rigid members are not optimized geometries.

microscopic.analyze_hole_electron_from_b.computes: Hole and electron densities of one excited state from an existing aTB1/TDA result (Multiwfn), without a new quantum calculation.

you_can_vary.fragments: named groups of 0-based atom indices for hole/electron sums

microscopic.analyze_hole_electron_from_b.returns: Hole-electron centroid distance, overlap, t-index, per-heavy-atom hole and electron contributions, per-fragment sums.
microscopic.analyze_hole_electron_from_b.does_not_tell: Unrelaxed vertical densities at one geometry; Mulliken partition; not a transfer rate.

microscopic.extract_geometry_descriptors.computes: Distances, angles and dihedrals on the geometry of an existing result (no calculation).

you_can_vary.measurements: lists of 2, 3 or 4 atom indices (distance, angle, dihedral)

microscopic.extract_geometry_descriptors.returns: The requested measurements, the atom map with coordinates, overall size descriptors.

microscopic.scan_cis_excitation_coordina.computes: Excited singlet states (RHF/6-31G/CIS, PySCF) at 2-4 fixed values of a bond length (e.g. a proton position) or a dihedral, with state tracking by transition density.

you_can_vary.state_root: which of the three lowest singlets to follow

microscopic.scan_cis_excitation_coordina.returns: Per point: S0 energy, singlet excitation energies and strengths, which state is followed, ambiguity flags.
microscopic.scan_cis_excitation_coordina.does_not_tell: Fixed (not relaxed) points at a low level of theory; not barriers, conical intersections or rates.

microscopic.evaluate_cis_s1_gradient.computes: S0 and S1 forces at the same geometry (RHF/6-31G/CIS, PySCF) and their difference.
microscopic.evaluate_cis_s1_gradient.returns: Per-atom S0 and S1 forces and the change on excitation (which atoms are pushed where in S1).
microscopic.evaluate_cis_s1_gradient.does_not_tell: Local forces at one geometry; not a relaxed S1 geometry, path or rate.

microscopic.evaluate_excited_state_gradi.computes: Energy and Cartesian forces of one excited singlet with TD-DFTB.
microscopic.evaluate_excited_state_gradi.does_not_tell: One geometry; no relaxation or path.

microscopic.compare_singlet_triplet_stat.computes: Vertical singlet and triplet states at one geometry with TD-DFTB (mio-1-1).
microscopic.compare_singlet_triplet_stat.returns: Singlet and triplet energies, singlet oscillator strengths, all singlet-triplet gaps.
microscopic.compare_singlet_triplet_stat.does_not_tell: No spin-orbit coupling, intersystem crossing rate or triplet yield.

microscopic.evaluate_spin_orbit_coupling.computes: Spin-orbit coupling magnitudes between S0-S3 and T1-T3 at one geometry (TD-DFTB + PySOC).
microscopic.evaluate_spin_orbit_coupling.returns: Coupling magnitudes (cm-1) for each singlet-triplet pair with the state energies.
microscopic.evaluate_spin_orbit_coupling.does_not_tell: Not rates or yields; light elements only.

microscopic.compare_spin_states_pyscf.computes: Vertical singlet and triplet states at one geometry with DFT (PBE or PBE0) / TDA (PySCF), def2 basis, scalar relativistic ECP for heavy atoms, with a reference-stability check.

you_can_vary.fragment_atom_indices: partition of all atoms for hole/electron populations

microscopic.compare_spin_states_pyscf.returns: Singlet and triplet energies, singlet oscillator strengths, singlet-triplet gaps, hole/electron populations per atom or fragment, SCF and stability status.
microscopic.compare_spin_states_pyscf.does_not_tell: No spin-orbit coupling, intersystem crossing rate or triplet yield; one geometry; expensive for heavy atoms.

microscopic.estimate_vertical_ip_ea.computes: Vertical ionization potential and electron affinity (IPEA-xTB) on an xTB-optimized geometry.
microscopic.estimate_vertical_ip_ea.returns: Vertical IP and EA in eV.
microscopic.estimate_vertical_ip_ea.does_not_tell: Whole-molecule values; not fragment levels, transfer free energies or rates.

microscopic.analyze_ground_state_vibrati.computes: Ground-state optimization and harmonic vibrational modes (GFN2-xTB).
microscopic.analyze_ground_state_vibrati.returns: Frequencies, atom-resolved displacements of each mode, low-frequency and imaginary modes.
microscopic.analyze_ground_state_vibrati.does_not_tell: Ground-state modes only; not excited-state displacements, couplings or nonradiative rates.

microscopic.sample_conformers_crest.returns: Atom-mapped conformer geometries with relative energies.

microscopic.search_dimer_contacts.computes: Search for optimized two-molecule arrangements (aISS docking + GFN2-xTB).

you_can_vary.partner_artifact_id: the second molecule (same id for a homodimer)

microscopic.search_dimer_contacts.returns: Per pose: interaction energy, closest intermolecular contacts, and a registered dimer geometry.
microscopic.search_dimer_contacts.does_not_tell: Modeled gas-phase dimers, not observed crystal packing or a bulk environment.

microscopic.compare_contact_torsion_resp.computes: The same rigid rotation of one bond (or fragment) inside a modeled dimer and in the isolated molecule (GFN2-xTB), separating the monomer's own strain from the change in contact interaction.

you_can_vary.atom_indices: 4 atom indices in the first molecule

microscopic.compare_contact_torsion_resp.returns: Energy versus angle in the dimer and isolated, the contact-interaction change, closest contacts; reusable rotated dimer geometries.
microscopic.compare_contact_torsion_resp.does_not_tell: Rigid responses in one modeled pose; not a relaxed barrier, an observed packing or a rate.

microscopic.scan_intermolecular_distance.computes: Rigid translation of one molecule of a modeled dimer along an atom-pair separation (GFN2-xTB).
microscopic.scan_intermolecular_distance.returns: Energy and contacts at each separation; reusable dimer geometries.
microscopic.scan_intermolecular_distance.does_not_tell: Not a relaxed path or a crystal; no excited states by itself.

combines: microscopic.analyze_hole_electron_from_bundle with the two molecules as fragments
